title: Rivière Hoops — Silver
category: Earrings (open C statement hoops on a post, about 35 mm, 1 row of oval clear cubic zirconia; sold as 1 pair)
metal: rhodium silver tone (PVD rhodium coating, per the listing), bright cool white high polish on the cup walls and post; no 18k gold tone variant
lock: 1 pair of open C hoops, 35 mm across, each with 1 straight post at its top end. Each hoop: 1 row of 15 slightly oval clear cubic zirconia, about 5 mm, facing front, each held by 4 claws in its own rounded cup with a fine beaded rim; cups touch edge to edge, giving a scalloped outline; plain polished inner side. Rhodium silver tone, high polish. Must stay separate oval stones in beaded cups, never a round-pavé tennis band or small huggie.
morph: The cups. Image models turn the 15 separate oval stones, each in its own 4-claw cup with a beaded (milgrain) rim, into a smooth tennis or eternity line of round prong-set brilliants with no metal between them (which is what the older Edition One huggie under this same SKU looked like), losing the beads and the scalloped outline. Second risk is shape and scale: the handle says 'huggies', so models shrink it into a small huggie, close the C into a full circle, add a hinged latch-back, or put stones on the plain inner side. In the October colour run the hoop read a little large beside a prop and the stones went soft in window light, so keep the light crisp and give it a size referent.
sizeMm: Approximately 35 mm across, give or take 1 mm (listing description says 'approximately 3.5cm across'; size-guide photo 06 says '35 mm across, oval stones 5 mm', with the 35 mm bar running from the top to the bottom of the hoop). Stones about 5 mm; each cup, and so the band, is about 6 mm wide (estimated from photo 06 against its 10 mm ruler). The C is about five sixths of a circle. Referents: about 1.3 times a Rs 10 coin (27 mm); worn (photo 02) it drops about 3.5 cm from the lobe, roughly two thirds of the ear's height. A statement hoop, not a huggie.

story: 'A ring of oval light' (the listing's own line). A riviere ('river' in French) is the old heirloom idea of a single line of stones, each set apart in its own collet, like a river of light; here that line is bent into a hoop. The beaded milgrain rims and claw-held ovals read antique and Edwardian, like grandmother's jewellery box, yet it costs Rs 1,499 (compare at Rs 2,149). At 35 mm it is a statement hoop made to be seen with hair up (the listing's styling tip: a bun or chignon). It rhymes with: a giant wheel at a mela at night, a ring of separately lit cabins; shisha mirrorwork, each tiny mirror held in its own stitched ring just as each stone sits in its own beaded cup; a row of diyas or fairy lights; a disco ball and the sangeet night (the October colour plate with a mirror disco ball scored 9.0, line 'Sangeet-ready.'); a gajra-wrapped bun; champagne bubbles, raindrops strung on a wire, ice; a chandelier. The cashew 'C-curve' rhyme was dropped in October because the stones went soft.
copyNotes: Use: Rivière Hoops, open hoop, statement hoop, slightly oval clear cubic zirconia, oval stones, each in its own beaded cup, milgrain, rhodium silver tone, PVD rhodium coating, 35 mm or 3.5 cm, 'a ring of oval light', river of light, hair up, pre-order, Rs 1,499. Avoid: 'huggie' or 'huggies' anywhere in copy (wrong shape for a 35 mm hoop, and an Indian nappy brand; the handle is the only place it appears), 'diamond', 'silver' or 'sterling', '925', 'white gold' or 'platinum' without saying rhodium silver tone, 'eternity', 'tennis', 'pave', 'round brilliant', 'hinged', 'mini', 'dainty' or 'small', any size other than 35 mm and 5 mm stones, and every claim badge: no tag backs waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic or sweatproof. Do not turn the description's 'anti-tarnish' into a claim. Because it is pre-order, never promise ships today or ready stock.

photos.shows: Main packshot: the pair on ivory plaster with a cream backdrop. The left hoop stands and shows the open C, its post at the top end, and the oval stones in beaded, 4-claw cups facing the camera. The right hoop lies nearly flat and shows the scalloped row of cups and the band's depth. Rhodium silver tone. Reference 1.
Worn: side profile of a woman with dark hair in a low bun. 1 hoop on the lobe hangs about 3.5 cm, both arms of the C showing stones. Rhodium silver tone. Best scale evidence. Reference 2.

Alternative: 1 hoop standing upright, nearly face-on, on ivory plaster. It is the clearest full view of the C, the post and all 15 cups (7 on the left arc, 2 at the bottom bend, 6 on the right arc). Rhodium silver tone. Same photo as the size guide, without the text.

Macro of the near arc on textured plaster: each oval stone held by 4 claws inside a beaded milgrain rim, with small rectangular windows in the polished cup walls. The far arc and post are blurred behind. Rhodium silver tone. Best evidence of the cups; reads huge, so do not use it for scale.
Packaging: the blush Naira Petite gift box on a wet white surface. The product is not visible.

Size guide: photo 03 with a 35 mm bar, a 10 mm ruler and the text '35 mm across, oval stones 5 mm. Measurements are approximate, give or take 1 mm.' Use as scale evidence only; the text overlay makes it unsuitable as a generation reference.
